appearance.wallpaperColors.hint: Accents and surfaces follow the Android wallpaper. Warnings and errors keep their color.
appearance.mapStyle.emptyHint: Leave empty for the default. Offline areas download from the light style.
appearance.mapStyle.error: Starts with http:// or https:// and names a host.
settings.shareSetup.sub: Settings, geofences and profiles as a link
syncInterval.sub.0: Each fix is its own request · radio never idles
syncInterval.sub.60: One request a minute · fixes wait in between
syncInterval.sub.300: One request every 5 min · fewer wake-ups
syncInterval.sub.900: One request every 15 min · the server hears you up to 15 min late
syncInterval.field.hint: Longer means fewer requests and a later server.
syncInterval.field.hintMin: At least {{min}} s. Longer means fewer requests and a later server.
trackingSync.intro: How often a fix is recorded and when it syncs. Changes apply at once and restart tracking.
trackingSync.custom.sub: Your own interval and movement threshold
trackingSync.interval.hint: At least 1 s. Shorter keeps the GPS awake more of the time and records more points.
trackingSync.distance.hint: Skips a fix closer than this to the last one. 0 keeps every fix. Saves storage, not battery.
trackingSync.batch.hint: {{min}} to {{max}} points per request. Larger means fewer requests and bigger payloads.
trackingSync.condition.any.sub: Mobile data and Wi-Fi · syncs never wait, counts against your data plan
trackingSync.condition.wifiAny.sub: Unmetered networks only · fixes wait on mobile data
trackingSync.condition.wifiSsid.sub: One network by name · fixes wait elsewhere
trackingSync.condition.vpn.sub: Only while a VPN is up · fixes wait otherwise
trackingSync.ssid.empty: Nothing syncs until a network is named
trackingSync.filter.on: Drops fixes the chip rates worse than {{threshold}}. Stricter leaves gaps indoors.
trackingSync.filter.off: Every fix is kept. When on, fixes worse than {{threshold}} are dropped.
trackingSync.threshold.hint: At least 1 {{unit}}. The chip's own estimate, often optimistic; lower drops more fixes.
connection.offline.hint: Locations stay on this device and nothing is sent.
connection.offline.unsent.title: Unsent locations
connection.offline.unsent.message_one: You have {{n}} location waiting to sync. What would you like to do?
connection.offline.unsent.message_other: You have {{n}} locations waiting to sync. What would you like to do?
connection.endpoint.helper: https for public hosts, http only for private hosts.
connection.endpoint.scheme: Starts with http:// or https:// and names a host.
connection.endpoint.publicHttp: http is refused for a public host. Use https.
connection.endpoint.privateHttp: Not encrypted: plain http on a private host.
connection.endpoint.key: This address carries a key. It is stored with settings, not encrypted, and included in setup links. Use a header where the server allows it.
connection.test.noEndpoint: Enter a server endpoint to test.
connection.test.fixAddress: Fix the address above to test.
connection.test.needsFix: Needs one recorded location to send. Start tracking first.
connection.test.localNetwork: Local network permission required to reach this server
template.custom.description: Your own field names, mapped by hand
requestFormat.intro: Customize field names sent to your server
requestFormat.method.post.sub: Sends the fields as a JSON body
requestFormat.method.get.sub: Sends the fields as URL query parameters
requestFormat.dawarich.batch.sub: Sends queued locations in one request
requestFormat.dawarich.batch.needsInterv: Needs a sync interval above Instant
requestFormat.dawarich.batch.needsPost: Needs the POST method, not GET
requestFormat.custom.empty: No custom fields. Add static key-value pairs to include in every payload.
requestFormat.duplicates: Duplicate field names: {{names}}. Resolve duplicates to save changes.
requestFormat.footer: Changes apply to new location data immediately
auth.basic.sub: Username and password, only safe over https
auth.removedOnSwitch: Choosing another method removes these credentials.
auth.headersHint: Sent with every request, like CF-Access-Client-Id for Cloudflare Access.
auth.duplicateHeader: Also used above. Only the last value is sent.
mtls.err.caRead: Could not read the selected file. Try a smaller file or pick again.
mtls.err.caInvalid: Not a valid X.509 certificate. Make sure you're picking the CA cert (PEM or DER).
mtls.err.readCert: Could not read the selected certificate
mtls.err.readFile: Could not read the selected file
mtls.pick.sub: Key stays in the device's credential store, survives a reinstall, never backed up.
mtls.import.sub: Key moves into the Android Keystore and the file password is discarded. Not backed up.
mtls.noPick: No certificate was picked. If the list was empty, install one in Android settings under Encryption & credentials first.
mtls.removeCa.title: Remove trusted CA?
mtls.removeCa.message: Connections to a server signed by it will fail until you import it again.
mtls.replace.title: Replace certificate
mtls.replace.message: The current certificate is replaced as soon as the new one is read.
mtls.remove.title: Remove client certificate?
mtls.remove.message: Requests to a server that requires it will fail until you add one again.
mtls.password.placeholder: Leave empty if the file has none
mtls.password.hint: Used once to unwrap the key, then discarded. Leave empty if the file has none.
mtls.client.none.caption: Only for a server that asks for one
mtls.ca.none.caption: Not needed for a public certificate
mtls.importCa.sub: For a private or self-signed CA. CAs you installed in Android settings are not used.
mtls.ca.note: Encrypted on this device and included in encrypted backups.
mtls.subject: Subject
